missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Период' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'был'. 'Этот' agrees in the masculine, and 'трудным' is an instrumental predicate adjective after 'был'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Период' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative equals the nominative as the object of 'пережили'. 'Тяжёлый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Периода' is the genitive after 'начало' to show which period's beginning is meant. 'Спокойным' is an instrumental predicate after 'было'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'В течение периода' uses the genitive 'периода' to express duration. 'Цены росли' is the nominative subject with its verb.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Периоду' is the dative after 'посвятить', which takes a dative for what something is dedicated to. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Периодом' is the instrumental required by 'интересоваться'. 'Этим' is the agreeing masculine instrumental demonstrative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В периоде' uses the prepositional 'периоде' after 'в' to express the time frame. 'Событий' is a genitive plural after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after preposition. 'О периоде' uses the prepositional 'периоде' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Трудном' is the agreeing masculine adjective.

missions.phrase: Эти периоды отличаются друг от друга.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Периоды' is the nominative plural subject of 'отличаются'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and the reflexive verb compares the eras.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Периоды' is the inanimate accusative plural, equal to the nominative plural, as the object of 'изучают'. 'Разные исторические' agree in the plural.
